svg.title: Responsive shell V1: initial static proposal
svg.desc: Wide navigation, token table and inspector; compact split; narrow browse and editor. Exact widths and transitions proposed for user discussion.
svg.text: INITIAL PROPOSAL · 15 November 2026 · static wireframes, not implementation or viewport qualification

svg.text: Browse → select row → Edit token. Back returns to this browsing view; it does not Cancel or discard.
The same draft stays alive when hidden, including Red = “12x”. Another target still uses the current departure guard.
Resize hides panes, never duplicates the editor. Focus in inspector → narrow edit; otherwise → narrow browse.
Compact Browse opens current project navigation as a modal drawer. Existing dialogs take priority; no stacked active modals.
Threshold candidates: wide ≥1120; split 880–1119; full-width below 880 CSS px. Validate content, zoom and height before agreement.
